Welcome to Sahito Veterinary Clinic, the official digital platform of Dr. Sumeer Sikander Sahito. Our mission is to bridge the gap between modern veterinary science and field practice.

​We provide high-quality, clinical insights into livestock health, specializing in cattle, buffalo, goats, and sheep. From complex surgical procedures and artificial insemination to life-saving vaccination protocols, we document real field cases to empower farmers and fellow professionals.

Step-by-step treatment guides and surgical insights.
Expert advice on livestock management and productivity.
#Animal Health Care Veterinary Hospital & Surgery Center in Gharo Golai.
